description:
The six published TPC-DS OBT SF1 bundles ran with query parameters set to `0` instead of dsqgen's values. The platforms are BigQuery, ClickHouse Local, Databricks, DataFusion, DuckDB and Snowflake. Their manifest sidecars carry `known_defects: ["defective-tpcds-obt-parameters"]`, so the explorer marks them `known_defective_data` and leaves them out of the rankings.

Rerun each platform at SF1 with the corrected queries and publish the new bundles. Then retire the defective bundles, or keep them as comparison-only history, following `results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md`. `results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md` records the defect.

The rerun waits for the conversion fix, because 17 statements still return no rows. Rerunning before that fix would publish results that are still wrong and would need a second rerun.
